body.statement: If \(p_{T,H}\) is invariant under the treatment-label flip group, then \(\pi_{iq}(T,H)=1/Q\) for all \(i\in T\) and \(q\in\mathcal Q\), so \(\widehat{\boldsymbol\tau}^{\mathrm{HT}}_T(H)\) equals the ordinary balanced factorial difference-in-means estimator. With fixed \(H\), its first-order limit reduces to the symmetric truncated-Gaussian factorial law of Li, Ding, and Rubin; with \(H=0\) in both waves, the pooled assignment has the full-sample balanced complete-randomization marginal.
body.justification: The reduction checks that exact-inclusion analysis preserves the established symmetric factorial design as a special case.
body.gap: The proposition is a required compatibility result rather than a novelty claim; the new content begins when pilot adaptation breaks label symmetry.
body.consumer: Practitioners can use the standard estimator whenever their preregistered score retains the flip symmetry.
